examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The site footer with its four link columns, social row, status line and language select. Clear `home` to drop the Azion mark, `statusLabel` to drop the status line, or `languages` to drop the select.

examples.name: Language
examples.summary: `v-model:language` binds the language select: the page seeds `PT-BR`, and choosing another option updates the line under the footer, where a site would switch its locale.
